title: Nash Melody/Free Parking/ Pool Open/Great Views
description:
Be in the heart of Nashville, Walk to Broadway in Minutes. The area offers all that Nashville has. Plenty of Entertainment along with New  Restaurants and coffee shops. We are close to the Titans Stadium, can be seen from the balcony, the Sounds Stadium is one block and the famed Predators. 
All this while relaxing at the pool with a view of the River just outside your door.
View Nashville's 4th of July Fireworks show from the pool!  Additional photos will be added soon on this event

The space
This is a wonderful condo apartment located on the Cumberland river in Nashville. The apartment has one private bedroom , one private bath, and a living room that opens to a balcony view. The living area has a trundle bed that pulls out providing 2 beds. The view off the balcony is of the pool, the river and the Titans Stadium is with in view.
The area is Booming, more places to visit, mingle, enjoy! ...more restaurants and entertainment venues are popping up!
